_note: Exact model identifiers and routes. No credentials are stored here. A backbone never falls back to another entry; failures are recorded as infrastructure failures.

excluded_candidates.gemini-3.8-flash: the manuscript pilot model; its free tier allows only 20 requests per day per project (429 QuotaFailure, quotaValue 20) so it cannot support the benchmark. Partial episodes are archived in runs/archive_gemini-3.8-flash_quota_limited/ and are not scored
excluded_candidates.ollama/qwen3.5:35b: installed locally but a 35B model; the ollama server is not running and loading it was not authorised/benchmarked
excluded_candidates.opencode/nemotron-3-ultra-free: responded in the probe but not selected (one OpenCode model chosen as third backbone)
excluded_candidates.other opencode free models: timed out or rate limited when probed on 2026-10-21 (see README, Model access)
